ui.note_calendar_date_only_hours: A date-only calendar row (time_known false) is anchored at the start of its local day and can happen at any time that day: it stays in the recent window until this many hours after its anchor (plus calendar_recent_hours).
ui.note_asset_page_bars_cache: The asset page (display only) reuses its one-minute bars read at most this many seconds ago: the page polls every few seconds and two days of crypto ticks are ~90,000 rows. Decisions and the regime always read fresh bars. 0 disables the reuse.
ui.note_daily_bars: GET /api/assets/{symbol} daily_bars: at most daily_bars_sessions sessions (stored daily bars, else official daily closes, else for a 24/7 asset the last hourly close of each completed UTC day). An overlay whose latest quote is a daily close, or that has fewer than 2 live one-minute bars, falls back to its last cross_asset_daily_sessions daily closes. Minute bars (charts and overlays) never include official daily closes.
ui.note_analysis_stale_cadences: The dashboard marks the full analysis stale when the last attempt failed, or when more than this many analysis cadences (refresh cadences.interpretation.seconds) passed since the last successful cycle finished. A cycle that is running is stale only when it started more than that after the last success or has itself run longer.
ui.note_dashboard_alerts: GET /api/dashboard carries the newest dashboard_alerts alerts and alerts_total, the number stored (GET /api/alerts pages through up to 500).
ui.note_social_corroboration_min_groups: An X post linked to a PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED event is shown CORROBORATED only when at least this many independent source groups support the event; otherwise UNVERIFIED.

http_compression.note: gzip for HTTP responses of at least minimum_bytes when the client accepts it (the dashboard and asset payloads are several hundred KB of JSON). WebSocket frames are not compressed by this middleware.
